callouts.label: Choose One Goal
callouts.hint: A child studies several icon-only trail choices at the starting point.
callouts.description: A useful personal goal is specific, realistic, and connected to something the student values.
callouts.ap_tip: Choose one focus instead of changing everything at once.

callouts.label: Take a Small First Action
callouts.hint: The child prepares a water bottle and walking shoes beside the stream.
callouts.description: Small repeatable actions make a goal easier to begin.
callouts.ap_tip: A first step should be possible today or this week.

callouts.label: Invite a Helper
callouts.hint: A supportive family member joins the trail.
callouts.description: Trusted adults, family, and friends can remind, model, listen, or make time.
callouts.ap_tip: Ask for the kind of support you actually want.

callouts.label: Adjust Around Obstacles
callouts.hint: A fallen log blocks one route while another safe path remains open.
callouts.description: Obstacles are information, not proof that a goal failed.
callouts.ap_tip: Change the plan while keeping the purpose.

callouts.label: Check Progress
callouts.hint: The child reviews an icon-only check-in board at an overlook.
callouts.description: A check-in asks what happened, what helped, and what needs adjustment.
callouts.ap_tip: Progress can be uneven and still be real.

callouts.label: Notice Feelings
callouts.hint: The child pauses among symbols of frustration, pride, and renewed calm.
callouts.description: Goals can bring mixed feelings. Naming them helps students respond rather than quit automatically.
callouts.ap_tip: Share strong or lasting feelings with a trusted adult.

callouts.label: Learn from Positive Models
callouts.hint: A trusted adult demonstrates and encourages without taking over.
callouts.description: Positive models show what a healthy action can look like.
callouts.ap_tip: A model supports choice; they do not control the goal.

callouts.label: Celebrate and Choose the Next Step
callouts.hint: The child celebrates effort beside several icon stones for what comes next.
callouts.description: Celebration recognizes effort, learning, and support—not just a perfect finish.
callouts.ap_tip: Reflect, then keep, revise, or replace the next action.
